data.gender_notes: Dosi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Dosi means 'gift of God'. This name is rooted in the ancient Greek belief that every child is a gift from the divine. In the Christian tradition, Dosi is a name for boys, representing the spiritual gift of faith and devotion. The name Dosi carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dosi usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Δωσι
in_greek.long_meaning: Δωσι είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει δωρεά ή δόσιος, δηλαδή αυτός που δίνει ή προσφέρει. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η έννοια της προσφοράς και της δωρεάς είναι σημαντική, ιδιαίτερα στο πλαίσιο της πνευματικής προσφοράς και της αγάπης προς τον πλησίον.

in_latin.name: Dosi
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dosi originem habet in lingua Latina et significat datum vel donum, id est, donatio vel munus. In ecclesia primitiva, donum et datum spiritualia magna habebant significatione, praesertim in contextu caritatis et amoris fraternitatis.
